name: Accessible (wheelchair symbol)
spec: blue square with the white wheelchair accessibility symbol
meaning: Facilities or parking for people with disabilities.

snippets.back: An accessible parking space may not be used without the required disability parking tag.
An accessible space needs both a valid placard or plate and the person it was issued to on board; the placard alone is not enough.

Never park at NO PARKING signs, crosswalks, sidewalks, driveways, ramp three-foot zones, wheelchair curbs, disabled crosshatch, zero-emission bays, tunnels, bridges, hydrant and station fifteen-foot zones, crosswalk twenty-foot zones or fifteen at curb extensions, safety gaps, or doubled up.
Obey the speed limit or go slower when needed to spot and react to pedestrians, and remember that children and wheelchair users sit lower and are harder to see.
Wheelchair-marked stalls belong to drivers holding disabled privileges alone, and speed boards post the fastest lawful pace for the stretch.
Accessible HAWK equipment can announce the WALK interval through sound and a vibrating arrow button.
Accessible pedestrian signals provide nonvisual crossing information through sounds, spoken messages or vibration.

Stop completely, yield, and take extra care around blind pedestrians with white canes tipped red or service animals, mobility-impaired people with walkers, crutches, orthopedic canes, wheelchairs, or guide dogs, and children or confused or incapacitated walkers.
